purpose: Correct proven Final V2-R2 evaluator false negatives and false positives without rewriting historical acceptance evidence.

changes.scenarioKey: Receipt scoring now uses applied override semantics, APPLIED/COMPARABLE status, entity, amount and delta. Agent-local scenarioKey remains usable only to connect that agent's own receipt and facts.
changes.identity: Anonymous display names in formal child facts are anonymousEntityProvenanceFacts, not proof of an invented formal identity. acceptedInventedIds is NOT_OBSERVABLE from frozen trace shape.
changes.moneyBasis: Only a single-money-fact atomic assertion may be classified by evaluator regex. A validator-valid and oracle-valid multi-role answer cannot be downgraded by weaker sentence-level regex.
changes.recipeDetail: Verified resolve_entity plus verified get_recipe_detail and the exact owner-visible recipe name support a recipe-detail oracle; child facts need not duplicate the parent display name.
changes.coilCount: A complete formally returned record set can support its count without a separately cited scalar count predicate.
changes.recipeDifference: A formally directional comparison queried in reverse is accepted when pair names and signed RIGHT_MINUS_LEFT delta are mathematically equivalent to the oracle pair.
